Iran's political establishment faces internal dissent after Khamenei's funeral

Following the funeral of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, internal dissent has emerged within the country's political establishment. Reports indicate anger and accusations, including claims of a coup, are being directed at leaders. This internal friction follows a period of public mourning and displays of defiance.
